<p class="ltx_p">*Week 2 — Cartesian Products and Cardinality</p>

<div id="p2" class="ltx_para">
<span class="ltx_ERROR undefined">{definition}</span>
<p class="ltx_p">Given sets <math id="p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A" display="inline"><mi>A</mi></math> and <math id="p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="B" display="inline"><mi>B</mi></math>, the <em class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">Cartesian product</em> <math id="p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A\times B" display="inline"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow></math> is the set of all ordered pairs <math id="p2.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(a,b)" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> with <math id="p2.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a\in A" display="inline"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>A</mi></mrow></math> and <math id="p2.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="b\in B" display="inline"><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow></math>.</p>
